description: Sentiment analysis with VADER (Hutto & Gilbert 2014; MIT), the lexicon-and-rules model tuned for social media, reviews and short text: compound score (-1..1), positive/neutral/negative proportions and a label, handling negation, intensifiers, ALL-CAPS, "but" contrast, punctuation emphasis, slang, emoticons and emoji. Per-sentence breakdown, or batch up to 50 texts with a summary. Scores match the reference implementation. Offline, English. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sentiment
